COAD.description: Colon adenocarcinoma. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task, Objective A.4): adult primary colonic mucosa DNase-seq, filling the open-chromatin gap alongside the existing TCGA ATAC coverage (a matched-tissue, non-tumor complement to the TCGA-tumor ATAC signal). encode_chromatin cell lines added 2026-09-07 (Martincorena et al. 2017 STAR Methods confirms dNdScv's matrix used Roadmap cell lines, prompting this search): HCT116, Caco-2, LoVo, SW480, HT-29, RKO -- six independent colon-cancer cell lines with native-GRCh38 ENCODE tracks, complementing the existing adult primary colonic mucosa DNase-seq. HCT116 is also this project's one existing Repli-seq source (GSE137764/MAT), so this reuses an already-vetted colon-cancer line rather than introducing a new one, plus five more independent colon lines.

BRCA.description: Breast invasive carcinoma. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task, Objective A.4): adult primary breast epithelium DNase-seq, filling the open-chromatin gap alongside the existing TCGA ATAC coverage. encode_chromatin cell lines added 2026-09-07: Martincorena et al. 2017's own STAR Methods (the primary dNdScv paper, not just the package/GitHub repo) confirms their 20-PC matrix was built from 63 Roadmap cell lines, not primary tissue -- a gap this registry hadn't checked before. Added MCF-7 (mammary gland adenocarcinoma, ENCODE's own native-GRCh38 ChIP-seq/DNase, 8/8 marks) and T47D (breast ductal carcinoma, DNase only), both real breast-cancer cell lines, complementing the existing adult primary breast epithelium DNase-seq rather than replacing it.

UCEC.description: Uterine Corpus Endometrial Carcinoma. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task): ENCODE has adult primary uterus tissue for 5 of our 7 default marks plus DNase -- H3K4me1, H3K9me3, H3K36me3, H3K27ac, H3K27me3 and DNase (one of two available adult uterus DNase experiments used). Missing H3K4me3 and H3K9ac (not released for this biosample). encode_chromatin cell line added 2026-09-07: Ishikawa (DNase-seq, native GRCh38) is a genuine endometrial adenocarcinoma cell line -- a disease-matched complement to the adult primary uterus tissue tracks above, not just an organ-level proxy. Found via Martincorena et al. 2017's STAR Methods confirming dNdScv's matrix is cell-line-based.

STAD.description: Stomach Adenocarcinoma. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task, Objective A.4): adult primary stomach tissue DNase-seq, filling the open-chromatin gap alongside the existing TCGA ATAC coverage.

TGCT.description: Testicular Germ Cell Tumors. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task): ENCODE has adult primary testis tissue for 6 of our 7 default marks plus DNase -- H3K4me1, H3K27ac, H3K27me3, H3K9me3, H3K36me3 and DNase all from the same 37yo donor; H3K4me3 only exists from a different (54yo) donor, used anyway since it's the only adult testis H3K4me3 available (a documented donor mismatch, not a tissue mismatch). Missing only H3K9ac. encode_chromatin cell line added 2026-09-07: NT2/D1 is a testicular embryonal carcinoma line -- a genuine TGCT-subtype cell line, not just a testis-tissue proxy -- with H3K9ac coverage, filling this cohort's one remaining mark gap (the adult primary testis tissue above is missing H3K9ac). Found via the same Martincorena et al. 2017 STAR-Methods-prompted ENCODE cell-line check as the other cohorts above. repliseq stays null, and that is a tested negative as of 2026-09-18, not an unfilled gap: H1 hESC (GSE137764 16-fraction MAT) was registered on a cell-of-origin argument and then dropped after measuring as nothing on this cohort -- held-out R^2 -0.0003 at matched n_components, ELPD within half a nat over 16852 genes, unchanged PIT calibration, and identical residual spatial autocorrelation. It also costs every chrX/chrY gene, the autosome-only MAT's standard price. No testis or germ-cell-tumor line exists in ENCODE's complete 182-experiment replication-timing catalog either.

OV.description: Ovarian Serous Cystadenocarcinoma. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task, Objective A.3): DNase-seq substituted for the missing TCGA ATAC-seq coverage (Corces et al. 2018 didn't profile ovarian cancer) -- adult primary ovary tissue DNase-seq exists natively on ENCODE (9 released adult experiments; one used here), unrelated to the ATAC gap since ATAC and DNase are separate assay catalogs.

SKCM.description: Skin Cutaneous Melanoma; GTEx representative column is sun-exposed skin (lower leg) since cutaneous melanoma is predominantly associated with sun-exposed body sites, not sun-shielded ones -- not-sun-exposed skin is also GTEx-mapped for the full covariate matrix. Roadmap eids are primary melanocyte cultures (E059, E061), matching melanoma's cell of origin rather than the broader skin fibroblast/keratinocyte epigenomes (E126/E127) also in the 127-panel. encode_chromatin (DNase) checked 2026-09-03 (Objective A.4) and NOT added: ENCODE's only melanocyte DNase-seq experiments are newborn foreskin or unspecified life stage (ENCSR518JGY, ENCSR434OBM, ENCSR000ELD) -- no adult sample exists, so left unfilled rather than using an age-mismatched proxy. encode_chromatin cell lines added 2026-09-07: SK-MEL-5 and COLO829 are real melanoma cell lines (DNase-seq only, native GRCh38) -- ENCODE has no adult melanocyte DNase (see above), but does have melanoma-line DNase, a different but genuinely disease-matched proxy. Found via Martincorena et al. 2017's STAR Methods confirming dNdScv's matrix is cell-line-based.

ACC.description: Adrenocortical Carcinoma. No adult adrenal/adrenocortical epigenome exists in Roadmap's 127-panel -- only E080 (Fetal Adrenal Gland), rejected as a tissue-stage mismatch, same rationale as UCEC/TGCT rejecting anatomically-close-but-wrong candidates. No adrenal/H295R cell line in ENCODE's ReplicationTimingSeries (22 series checked) or GEO GSE137764 (H1/H9/HCT116-only, confirmed). encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task): ENCODE's own native-GRCh38 experiments cover adult primary adrenal gland tissue directly (a female, 41yo donor) for 5 of our 7 default marks plus DNase -- a source Roadmap's 127-panel never had. H3K9ac and H3K27ac have no released adult adrenal gland experiment on ENCODE (checked via the full organ_slims=adrenal+gland Histone ChIP-seq listing, not a per-mark miss); left unfilled rather than substituting a cell line.

BLCA.description: Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma. No bladder/urothelial/urinary anatomy category exists in Roadmap's standard 127-panel (checked the full EID_metadata.tab, not just a candidate shortlist). No bladder-derived cell line in ENCODE's ReplicationTimingSeries (28 series checked across both the UW 6-fraction and Gilbert wavelet cohorts) or GEO GSE137764 (H1/H9/HCT116-only, confirmed). encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task): ENCODE has adult primary urinary bladder tissue (same male donor) for 4 of our 7 default marks -- H3K4me1, H3K27ac, H3K4me3, H3K36me3. Missing H3K9ac, H3K9me3, H3K27me3 (not released for this biosample). The only bladder DNase-seq experiment on ENCODE (ENCSR813CKU) is embryonic, not adult -- rejected as a tissue-stage mismatch, same rationale ACC/UCEC/TGCT already use for rejecting Roadmap's fetal-only candidates. encode_chromatin cell line added 2026-09-07: an ENCODE urothelium cell line (DNase-seq, native GRCh38) -- this cohort's first DNase source of any kind (the primary-tissue marks above have no matching adult bladder DNase-seq experiment). Found via Martincorena et al. 2017's STAR Methods confirming dNdScv's matrix is cell-line-based, which prompted this ENCODE classification=cell+line check.

CESC.description: Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma and Endocervical Adenocarcinoma. GTEx representative column is Cervix_Ectocervix (squamous epithelium) since squamous carcinoma is the majority histology in this cohort. Roadmap's only cervix entry is E117 (HeLa-S3), a cervical cancer cell line rather than primary tissue -- same rationale as using K562 for LAML, the best available match when no normal-tissue epigenome exists for this anatomy. HeLa-S3 is also in ENCODE's UW 6-fraction Repli-seq cohort, so both roadmap and repliseq use the same cell line here. encode_chromatin (DNase) checked 2026-09-03 (Objective A.4) and NOT added: ENCODE has zero cervix/ectocervix/endocervix DNase-seq experiments at all (searchTerm queries for all three return no results) -- not just no adult match, no match of any kind. encode_chromatin cell line added 2026-09-07: HeLa-S3 is already this cohort's Roadmap (E117) and Repli-seq choice (see above) -- ENCODE's own native-GRCh38 ChIP-seq/DNase experiments for the same cell line (8/8 marks, independent from Roadmap's hg19 consolidated signal) were not yet pulled in as encode_chromatin. Added now; still the best-available cervical-cancer cell-line match, same caveat as before (a cell line, not normal tissue).

CHOL.description: Cholangiocarcinoma. GTEx maps to Liver/Liver_Portal_Tract; Roadmap and repliseq both use liver-tissue/liver-cell-line sources (E066 primary liver, E118/HepG2 hepatocellular line) since no bile-duct-specific epigenome or cell line exists in either resource -- HepG2 is a hepatocyte line, not cholangiocyte, so this is the best available organ-level proxy rather than a cell-type match, same caveat pattern as CESC's HeLa-S3 use. HepG2 is also in ENCODE's UW 6-fraction Repli-seq cohort (same assay family as MCF-7/HeLa-S3), all 6 fractions present. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task, Objective A.4): adult primary liver tissue DNase-seq (not HepG2 -- same organ-level-proxy caveat as the marks/repliseq above, but a real tissue sample rather than a cell line where one exists for this assay). encode_chromatin cell lines added 2026-09-07: HuH-7 and HuH-7.5 (DNase-seq, native GRCh38) are hepatocellular carcinoma lines distinct from HepG2 above -- still the same organ-level (liver, not bile-duct) proxy caveat as HepG2's use in Roadmap/Repli-seq, but two independent additional liver-cancer lines' open-chromatin signal. Found via Martincorena et al. 2017's STAR Methods confirming dNdScv's matrix is cell-line-based.

DLBC.description: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. GTEx maps to Whole_Blood/Spleen (no lymph-node column in GTEx). No TCGA ATAC-seq coverage (atac: null). Roadmap uses E032 (primary B cells from peripheral blood, the direct cell-of-origin match, 6/7 marks -- H3K9ac 404s) plus E062 (primary PBMCs, broader immune mix, 7/7 marks) for fuller coverage, same two-epigenome pattern as CHOL/CESC. Repliseq uses GM12878 (EBV-transformed lymphoblastoid B-cell line), the standard ENCODE UW 6-fraction Repli-seq series, hg19, all 6 fractions live-verified -- the closest available cell-type match for a B-cell malignancy, analogous to CHOL's HepG2/BRCA's MCF-7 choices. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task, Objective A.3): DNase-seq substituted for the missing TCGA ATAC-seq coverage, same rationale as OV -- adult primary peripheral-blood B cell DNase-seq exists natively on ENCODE (8 released adult experiments; one used here), matching E032's cell-of-origin choice. encode_chromatin cell lines added 2026-09-07: Karpas-422, OCI-LY1, OCI-LY3, OCI-LY7 and SU-DHL-6 are actual diffuse large B-cell lymphoma cell lines (not just blood/lymphoid-adjacent like GM12878/E032/E062 above) -- the closest cell-type match this registry has found for any cohort, found via Martincorena et al. 2017's STAR Methods confirming dNdScv's own matrix is cell-line-based, which prompted checking ENCODE's classification=cell+line facet for a disease-matched line here.

ESCA.description: Esophageal Carcinoma. GTEx maps to Esophagus_Mucosa/Esophagus_Muscularis/Esophagus_Gastroesophageal_Junction; representative column is Mucosa (the epithelial layer, tumor cell-of-origin). Note the cohort itself mixes two genomically distinct histologies (squamous cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma, the latter overlapping gastric/GEJ biology) -- a caveat for interpreting results, not something the covariate matrix can resolve. TCGA ATAC-seq covered (1 UUID, live-verified via GDC /data GET -- /files metadata 404s for this UUID the same way it does for CHOL's, a known GDC quirk, not a bad UUID). Roadmap uses E079 (Esophagus, the direct organ match, 6/7 marks -- H3K9ac 404s). No esophageal, gastric, or GI-tract cell line exists in ENCODE's Repli-seq experiment set or GEO GSE137764's MAT set (H1/H9/HCT116 only) -- repliseq is null, same as OV. encode_chromatin added 2026-09-03 (expanded-covariate-sources task, Objective A.4): adult primary esophagus (squamous epithelium) DNase-seq, filling the open-chromatin gap alongside the existing TCGA ATAC coverage.

GBM.description: Glioblastoma multiforme. GTEx maps to the 13 Brain_* columns (representative Brain_Cortex). TCGA ATAC-seq covered (Corces et al. 2018). Roadmap uses E073 (dorsolateral prefrontal cortex) and E072 (inferior temporal lobe) -- GBM is supratentorial and commonest in the frontal and temporal lobes; both adult composite epigenomes from the same two donors (75Y/81Y), 7/7 marks each -- plus E125 (NH-A astrocytes, primary culture, 7/7, age unrecorded), the cell-of-origin match on the same reasoning as DLBC's E032. All 21 (EID, mark) pairs live-verified 200 on 2026-10-01 (of the brain epigenomes checked, only E071 hippocampus lacks H3K9ac). Fetal/neurosphere epigenomes (E053, E054, E070, E081, E082) rejected as non-adult. encode_chromatin: DNase-seq only, filling the open-chromatin gap Roadmap's 7-mark panel leaves -- adult DLPFC (ENCSR982XOK, 71y male, the youngest DLPFC donor without a cognitive-impairment or Alzheimer's diagnosis; a different donor from Roadmap's) and primary astrocyte (ENCSR000EPM, NH-A). ENCODE's native-GRCh38 brain histone tracks were not added: the donors with full mark coverage are Roadmap's own E067-E074 donors, so they would duplicate E073/E072 in another assembly, and the NH-A histone set is E125's cells. Cell lines: the five glioma lines in ENCODE's 211-line panel, all DNase only (no glioma line has histone ChIP-seq): U-87 MG, A172, M059J and H54 (glioblastoma) and H4 (neuroglioma); neuroblastoma (SK-N-SH, BE2C, SK-N-DZ), Ewing-family (SK-N-MC) and medulloblastoma (Daoy, D341Med, D721Med) lines rejected. repliseq null: no glioma, astrocyte or adult-brain replication-timing source exists; hESC-derived neural progenitor Repli-chip (ENCSR497CCF, wavelet, hg19) is a cell-of-origin candidate not yet measured. Assemblies: Roadmap hg19, encode_chromatin and ATAC GRCh38.

HNSC.description: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (oral cavity, oropharynx, hypopharynx, larynx). GTEx maps to Minor_Salivary_Gland/Esophagus_Mucosa; representative column is Esophagus_Mucosa (stratified squamous epithelium, the tumor cell of origin; GTEx has no oral mucosa). TCGA ATAC-seq covered (Corces et al. 2018; the tarball's bigWigs are named HNSC_<uuid>..., read from its first member). No oral, pharyngeal or laryngeal epigenome exists in Roadmap's panel, so roadmap uses E079 (Esophagus, adult squamous mucosa, 6/7 marks -- H3K9ac 404s) plus E127 (NHEK epidermal keratinocytes, 7/7, life stage unrecorded), the squamous-keratinocyte cell of origin; E057/E058 (foreskin keratinocytes) rejected as newborn. All 14 (EID, mark) pairs live-checked 2026-10-01. encode_chromatin: adult esophagus squamous epithelium from one ENTEx donor (ENCDO845WKR, 37y) -- six histone marks (all but H3K9ac, which that donor lacks) plus DNase-seq, a different donor and assembly from Roadmap's E079; newest (2020) GRCh38 files, single replicate as that donor has. Rejected: tongue DNase (embryonic only), gingival/periodontal fibroblasts (stromal), ACC112 (adenoid cystic carcinoma, a salivary glandular tumor, not squamous). Cell lines: none -- ENCODE's ChIP-seq/DNase panel has no HNSCC line (FaDu, SCC-25, SCC-9, Detroit 562, Cal 27 and UM-SCC lines all absent); NCI-H226 (lung squamous) rejected as a different organ. repliseq: keratinocyte (ENCODE UW 6-fraction Repli-seq, hg19, life stage unrecorded), the squamous cell of origin -- registered as a direct cell-type match like MCF-7 (BRCA) and GM12878 (DLBC), the same reasoning that made keratinocyte the wrong cell for SKCM. Assemblies: Roadmap and repliseq hg19, encode_chromatin and ATAC GRCh38.

KICH.description: Kidney chromophobe renal cell carcinoma (arises from intercalated cells of the distal nephron / collecting duct). GTEx maps to Kidney_Cortex/Kidney_Medulla; representative column is Kidney_Cortex. No TCGA ATAC-seq coverage (atac: null; Corces et al. 2018 covers KIRC and KIRP, not KICH). roadmap null: Roadmap's only kidney epigenome is E086 Fetal Kidney (17 gestational weeks), rejected as fetal, and HEK293 is not in the panel (and is embryonic). encode_chromatin: one adult ENCODE kidney donor (ENCDO646IOH, 50y) for six histone marks -- H3K4me1, H3K4me3, H3K9ac, H3K9me3, H3K27ac, H3K36me3; no adult kidney H3K27me3 exists on ENCODE -- plus adult DNase-seq from whole kidney (47y) and cortex of kidney (70y), newest GRCh38 files, single replicate as those donors have. Rejected: the many embryonic kidney tissues, single-cell-type primary cultures (proximal tubule, glomerular, tubule, renal cortical epithelium) and HK-2. Cell lines: none -- no chromophobe RCC line exists on ENCODE; Caki2 and RCC 7860 (786-O) are clear-cell RCC, ACHN a papillary-like renal adenocarcinoma, 'RCC' (EFO:0000681) an unsubtyped renal cell carcinoma of unknown source, G401 a pediatric rhabdoid tumor, HEK293/HEK293T embryonic -- all different diseases or life stages. repliseq null: the human replication-timing universe has no intercalated-cell, collecting-duct or chromophobe source; Caki2's Gilbert wavelet is clear-cell RCC (proximal-tubule origin), an organ-level proxy declined on the same grounds as SKCM's keratinocyte. Assemblies: encode_chromatin GRCh38.

KIRC.description: Kidney renal clear cell carcinoma (arises from proximal tubule epithelium in the renal cortex). GTEx maps to Kidney_Cortex/Kidney_Medulla; representative column is Kidney_Cortex, the tumor's site. TCGA ATAC-seq covered (Corces et al. 2018; the tarball's bigWigs are named KIRC_<uuid>..., read from its first member). roadmap null: Roadmap's only kidney epigenome is E086 (fetal kidney), rejected as fetal, same as KICH. encode_chromatin: the same adult kidney tissue as KICH -- one ENTEx-style donor (ENCDO646IOH, 50y) with six histone marks (no adult kidney H3K27me3 exists on ENCODE), plus DNase-seq from adult cortex of kidney (70y, the tumor's site) and whole kidney (47y); newest GRCh38 files, single replicate as those donors have. Cell lines: Caki2 and RCC 7860 (786-O), both genuine clear-cell RCC lines, disease-matched; ENCODE has DNase only for them (no histone ChIP-seq), newest (2025) replicate-1 read-depth normalized files. Rejected: ACHN (papillary-like renal adenocarcinoma, a different disease), the generic 'RCC' line (no subtype, unknown source), G401 (pediatric rhabdoid tumor), HEK293/293T (embryonic), embryonic kidney tissues and single-cell-type primary cultures. repliseq: Caki2, the Gilbert lab's 2-fraction early/late series (ENCSR868SPM), whose only processed output is one wavelet-smoothed log2(early/late) bigWig (hg19; larger = earlier, opposite to mrt) -- a disease-matched clear-cell RCC line, the first wavelet-type row; to be measured as TGCT's and HNSC's blocks were. Assemblies: repliseq hg19; encode_chromatin and ATAC GRCh38.

LGG.description: Brain lower grade glioma (WHO grade 2-3 astrocytomas and oligodendrogliomas, mostly IDH-mutant). Same tissue as GBM, so the covariate sources are GBM's: GTEx maps to the 13 Brain_* columns (representative Brain_Cortex). TCGA ATAC-seq covered (Corces et al. 2018; the tarball's bigWigs are named LGGx_<uuid>..., read from its first member, so the prefix is lggx). Roadmap uses E073 (dorsolateral prefrontal cortex) and E072 (inferior temporal lobe), adult composite epigenomes from the same two donors (75Y/81Y), 7/7 marks each, plus E125 (NH-A astrocytes, 7/7, age unrecorded), the astrocytoma cell-of-origin match; all 21 (EID, mark) pairs re-verified 200 on 2026-10-03. Roadmap has no oligodendrocyte or OPC epigenome (only fetal neurospheres E053/E054, the fetal germinal matrix E070 and hESC-derived neural progenitors/neurons E007/E009/E010, all rejected as non-adult), and ENCODE has no oligodendrocyte, OPC or white-matter DNase/histone experiment at all (searched 2026-10-03; only embryonic radial glia), so the oligodendroglioma lineage has no matched source. encode_chromatin: DNase-seq only -- adult DLPFC (ENCSR982XOK, 71y male) and primary astrocyte (ENCSR000EPM, NH-A), plus the five glioma lines in ENCODE's cell-line panel (U-87 MG, A172, M059J and H54, glioblastoma; H4, neuroglioma); no lower-grade glioma line (Hs683, SW1088, SW1783) exists in ENCODE. repliseq null: no glioma, astrocyte, oligodendrocyte or adult-brain replication-timing source exists. Assemblies: Roadmap hg19, encode_chromatin and ATAC GRCh38.

KIRP.description: Kidney renal papillary cell carcinoma (arises, like clear-cell RCC, from proximal tubule epithelium in the renal cortex). GTEx maps to Kidney_Cortex/Kidney_Medulla; representative column is Kidney_Cortex, the tumor's site. TCGA ATAC-seq covered (Corces et al. 2018; the tarball's bigWigs are named KIRP_<uuid>..., read from its first member). roadmap null: Roadmap's only kidney epigenome is E086 (fetal kidney), rejected as fetal, same as KICH and KIRC. encode_chromatin: the same adult kidney tissue as KICH and KIRC -- one donor (ENCDO646IOH, 50y) with six histone marks (no adult kidney H3K27me3 exists on ENCODE), plus DNase-seq from adult cortex of kidney (70y, the tumor's site) and whole kidney (47y); newest GRCh38 files, single replicate as those donors have. Cell line: ACHN, annotated by Cellosaurus (CVCL_1067) as papillary renal cell carcinoma (NCIt C6975; from a pleural-effusion metastasis of a 22-year-old man), disease-matched; ENCODE has DNase only for it (no histone ChIP-seq), newest (2025) replicate-1 read-depth normalized file. Rejected: Caki2 and RCC 7860 (786-O) DNase (clear-cell RCC, a different disease), the generic 'RCC' line (no subtype), G401 (pediatric rhabdoid tumor), HEK293/293T (embryonic). repliseq: Caki2, the Gilbert lab's wavelet-smoothed log2(early/late) series (ENCSR868SPM; hg19; larger = earlier, opposite to mrt) -- a clear-cell RCC line, not papillary, registered on a cell-of-origin argument (both RCCs arise from proximal tubule epithelium; no papillary or other proximal-tubule RT source exists in the mapped human RT catalog) and to be measured with rt_block_scoping as TGCT's, HNSC's and KIRC's blocks were; drop it if it measures as nothing. Assemblies: repliseq hg19; encode_chromatin and ATAC GRCh38.

LAML.description: Acute myeloid leukemia. GTEx maps to Whole_Blood (representative gtex_whole_blood). Tumor samples are 'Primary Blood Derived Cancer - Peripheral Blood' (sample type 03, kept by select_tcga_maf_files' default 01/03); GDC has 153 open masked-somatic MAFs over 144 cases and 151 STAR-count RNA-seq files (queried 2026-10-03). No TCGA ATAC-seq (not in Corces et al. 2018), atac null. Roadmap uses E051 (G-CSF-mobilized CD34+ hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells, male 42Y -- AML's cell of origin; 5/7 marks, H3K9ac and H3K27ac 404), E029 (primary peripheral-blood monocytes, adult; 6/7, H3K9ac 404) and E124 (CD14+ monocytes, ENCODE2012; 7/7) -- the myeloid lineage; all 21 (EID, mark) pairs live-checked 2026-10-03. Rejected as non-adult by Roadmap's own AGE field: E035/E036 (primary HSC), E050 (mobilized HSC, female, 'Fetus') and E030 (neutrophils, 'Fetus'); E062 (PBMC) left out as lymphocyte-dominated. encode_chromatin: adult common myeloid progenitor, CD34-positive, one 33y female donor (ENCDO412QUR): H3K27ac, H3K27me3, H3K36me3, H3K4me1, H3K4me3, H3K9me3 and DNase (no H3K9ac exists for this cell type), plus adult CD14-positive monocyte DNase (21y male). Cell lines: the AML lines in ENCODE's panel -- HL-60 (H3K4me3, H3K27ac, H3K27me3, DNase), NB4 (APL; H3K4me3, DNase), and DNase-only Kasumi-1, SKNO-1 (t(8;21) AML), MOLM-13 and OCI-AML2 (both 0.1% DMSO vehicle controls, the only DNase they have), THP-1 (acute monocytic leukemia) and CMK (acute megakaryoblastic leukemia). K562 not used for chromatin: it is CML in blast crisis (BCR-ABL, erythroleukemic), not AML, and it is already in GENERIC's cell-line pool. repliseq: K562 (ENCODE UW 6-fraction Repli-seq, hg19), the only myeloid-leukemia line in the human RT catalog -- disease-proximal rather than disease-matched (a myeloid blast line, as GM12878 is a B-cell line for DLBC), registered to be measured with rt_block_scoping; the hESC-derived 'myeloid cell' and 'hematopoietic multipotent progenitor cell' Repli-chip profiles rejected as embryonic in-vitro differentiations. Assemblies: Roadmap and repliseq hg19, encode_chromatin GRCh38.

LUAD.description: Lung adenocarcinoma. GTEx maps to Lung (representative column gtex_lung). TCGA ATAC-seq covered (Corces et al. 2018; the tarball's bigWigs are named LUAD_<uuid>..., read from its first member, so the prefix is luad). Roadmap uses E096 (adult lung primary tissue, 30Y female; 6/7 marks, H3K9ac 404s), the only adult lung epigenome in the panel; E088 (fetal lung) and E017 (IMR-90 fetal lung fibroblast) rejected as non-adult, E128 (NHLF lung fibroblasts) as stromal, and E114 (A549, ethanol-treated) left out in favour of ENCODE's native GRCh38 A549 tracks below. All 7 E096 (EID, mark) pairs live-checked 2026-10-03. encode_chromatin: adult lung from one ENTEx donor (ENCDO451RUA, 54M, upper lobe of left lung -- the commonest LUAD site): H3K27ac, H3K27me3, H3K36me3, H3K4me1, H3K4me3, H3K9me3 and DNase-seq, newest GRCh38 files (single-replicate, as that donor has); ENCODE has no adult lung H3K9ac. Roadmap's own E096 donor (ENCDO424HVB) is not reused, to avoid duplicating E096 in another assembly. Cell lines: the two lung adenocarcinoma lines in ENCODE's panel -- A549 (KRAS-mutant; untreated Reddy-lab H3K27ac/H3K4me1/H3K4me3/H3K9me3 and DNase, ethanol-vehicle Bernstein-lab H3K27me3/H3K36me3/H3K9ac, the only ones for those marks) and PC-9 (EGFR exon-19 deletion; all 7 marks and DNase, untreated), pooled-replicate fold-change files where available. Rejected: the small-cell lines (NCI-H69, H82, H146, H187, H209, H345, H446, H510A, H524, H748, H889, H1092, H1436, H1694, H1930, H2081, H2107, H2171, H2196, SHP77, COLO668), NCI-H460 (large-cell carcinoma), NCI-H226 (squamous), and the fetal lung fibroblasts IMR-90, WI38, AG04450, AG08396. repliseq: A549's Gilbert-lab wavelet-smoothed early/late signal (ENCSR593FTB, hg19), a disease-matched lung adenocarcinoma line -- registered like KIRC's Caki2, to be measured with the own-RT-block test. Assemblies: Roadmap and repliseq hg19, encode_chromatin and ATAC GRCh38.

LIHC.description: Liver hepatocellular carcinoma. GTEx maps to Liver/Liver_Hepatocyte/Liver_Portal_Tract/Liver_Mixed_Cell; representative column Liver. TCGA ATAC-seq covered (Corces et al. 2018; the tarball's bigWigs are named LIHC_<uuid>..., read from its first member). Roadmap uses E066 (adult liver, 7/7 marks) plus E118 (HepG2, 7/7), all 14 (EID, mark) pairs live-checked 2026-10-03. HepG2 is a hepatoblastoma line from a 15-year-old, not an HCC, so it is a liver-cancer proxy rather than a disease match -- kept because it is the one liver-cancer epigenome Roadmap has (CHOL uses it on the same terms). encode_chromatin: one adult donor's right lobe of liver (ENCDO575WHY, 41y; Bernstein lab, 2022) -- six histone marks (no H3K9ac exists for that donor) plus DNase-seq, newest GRCh38 files, single replicate as that donor has. The 2013 adult 'liver' tissue donors (Bing Ren lab, Roadmap REMC award) are E066's own source and were not added, to avoid duplicating E066 in another assembly; ENCODE's native HepG2 histone set likewise duplicates E118. Also DNase from primary hepatocytes (the HCC cell of origin; life stage unrecorded, as for E125 in GBM) and from the HCC lines HuH-7 and HuH-7.5 (2020 files). No other HCC line (Hep 3B, PLC/PRF/5, SK-HEP-1, SNU, Huh-1, JHH) has any ENCODE experiment; hepatic stellate cells rejected (not the cell of origin), embryonic and child liver tissue rejected by life stage. repliseq: HepG2 (ENCODE UW 6-fraction Repli-seq, hg19; phases G1b/S1-S4/G2 checked per file), a liver-cancer line -- registered as a disease-proximal source, to be measured with rt_block_scoping and dropped if it moves nothing. Assemblies: Roadmap and repliseq hg19, encode_chromatin and ATAC GRCh38.

MESO.description: Malignant mesothelioma, overwhelmingly pleural in TCGA (51 of 87 cases pleura NOS, 11 thorax NOS, 5 abdominal/peritoneal; 52 epithelioid, 21 biphasic). GTEx has no mesothelium or pleura tissue, so MESO had no GTEx mapping: the proposed mapping key MESO takes Lung (the organ the visceral pleura covers, representative column) and Adipose_Visceral_Omentum (the peritoneal surface tissue GTEx samples), both organ-level proxies in which mesothelial cells are a minor fraction -- read the GTEx block as tissue context, not cell of origin. Expression is tumor-only: all 87 TCGA-MESO RNA-seq files are primary tumors, no normals. TCGA ATAC-seq covered (Corces et al. 2018; the tarball's bigWigs are named MESO_<uuid>..., read from its first member). roadmap null: Roadmap's 127 epigenomes include no mesothelial, pleural or peritoneal sample (adipose E025/E063 and lung E096 are the wrong cell). encode_chromatin: DNase-seq of NCI-H226, the only mesothelioma line in ENCODE (Cellosaurus CVCL_1544: pleural epithelioid mesothelioma, originally described as lung squamous carcinoma; ENCODE health status 'squamous cell carcinoma; mesothelioma'), no histone ChIP exists for it; 2025 pipeline replicate-1 file. NCI-H2052, NCI-H28, NCI-H2452, MSTO-211H, Met-5A and LP-9 return no ENCODE experiments. Rejected: ENCODE's 'mesothelial cell of epicardium' (in vitro differentiated, embryonic) and adult omental fat pad DNase (mostly adipose, not mesothelium); ENCODE has no adult pleura or peritoneum chromatin. repliseq null: no adult or tumor mesothelial replication-timing source exists; hESC-derived 'mesothelial cell' Repli-chip (ENCSR401KWO, ENCSR326SZT; wavelet, hg19, embryonic) is noted as an unmeasured candidate only. With so little tissue-matched chromatin, MESO is the cohort that stands to gain most from the complete GENERIC. Assemblies: encode_chromatin and ATAC GRCh38.

LUSC.description: Lung squamous cell carcinoma. GTEx maps to Lung (representative gtex_lung). TCGA ATAC-seq covered (Corces et al. 2018; the tarball's bigWigs are named LUSC_<uuid>..., read from its first member). Roadmap uses E096 (adult lung, 6/7 marks -- H3K9ac 404s, as for LUAD) plus E127 (NHEK epidermal keratinocytes, 7/7, life stage unrecorded), the squamous-epithelium proxy for the airway basal cells LUSC arises from after squamous metaplasia (Roadmap has no bronchial or airway epithelial epigenome; E128 lung fibroblasts are stromal). All 14 (EID, mark) pairs live-checked 2026-10-03. encode_chromatin: LUAD's ENTEx adult lung donor (ENCDO451RUA, 54y male, upper lobe of left lung; six histone marks plus DNase -- a different donor and assembly from Roadmap's E096), plus primary bronchial epithelial cells (ENCODE/UW donor ENCDO106AAA, life stage unrecorded): DNase, H3K4me3, H3K27me3 and H3K36me3, the only marks that cell type has; a retinoic-acid-treated bronchial epithelial DNase was rejected. Cell lines: none -- ENCODE has no lung squamous carcinoma line (NCI-H520, SK-MES-1, Calu-1, HCC95, LK-2, EBC-1 and others all absent); NCI-H226, historically labelled lung squamous, is annotated by Cellosaurus (CVCL_1544) as pleural epithelioid mesothelioma and was rejected; adenocarcinoma (A549, PC-9), large-cell (NCI-H460) and small-cell lines rejected. repliseq: keratinocyte (ENCODE UW 6-fraction Repli-seq, hg19), the squamous cell-of-origin match HNSC uses; A549 (Gilbert wavelet) is the organ match but an adenocarcinoma and was not used. Assemblies: Roadmap and repliseq hg19, encode_chromatin and ATAC GRCh38.

PAAD.description: Pancreatic adenocarcinoma (mostly ductal adenocarcinoma, PDAC). GTEx maps to Pancreas (plus Islets, Acini, Mixed_Cell); representative column is Pancreas. No TCGA ATAC-seq coverage (PAAD is not in Corces et al. 2018; atac: null). TCGA-PAAD has 4 Solid Tissue Normal RNA-seq files, so the default Tumor+Normal gexp tissue types stay, the normal mean resting on only 4 samples. Roadmap uses E098 (adult pancreas, 6/7 marks -- H3K9ac 404s; live-checked 2026-10-03); E087 (pancreatic islets, 7/7) rejected as the wrong compartment: endocrine islets are a small fraction of the gland and not the ductal/acinar cell of origin of PDAC. encode_chromatin: adult pancreas tissue from one donor (ENCDO575WHY, 41y, Bernstein lab 2020-21; the same donor as LIHC's liver tracks) -- six histone marks (ENCODE has no adult whole-pancreas H3K9ac) plus DNase-seq; the 2013 Bing Ren pancreas donors are likely E098's own source and were not reused. Cell lines: the only pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma lines in ENCODE -- Panc1 (PANC-1; six marks plus DNase, newest combined-replicate files) and 8988T (PA-TU-8988T; DNase only) -- plus HPDE6-E6E7 (DNase), an HPV-E6/E7-immortalized normal pancreatic ductal epithelial line, the ductal cell-of-origin match. Capan-1, AsPC-1, BxPC-3, MIA PaCa-2, HPAF-II, CFPAC-1, SU.86.86, PSN1, Panc 10.05, KP-4, Capan-2 and Hs 766T have no ENCODE experiments. repliseq null: no pancreatic replication-timing source exists in the ENCODE Repli-seq/Repli-chip catalog or GSE137764; the Repli-chip endodermal, posterior foregut and endocrine-cell profiles are hESC-derived in-vitro intermediates (embryonic) and were rejected. TCGA-PAAD tumors are stroma-rich and often low purity, so purity/VAF-shape QC exclusions are expected. Assemblies: Roadmap hg19, encode_chromatin GRCh38.

GENERIC.description: Tissue-agnostic pan-tissue covariate pool, not a TCGA study code -- see sigmutselcovs' DEVELOPMENT.md, 'Generic (pan-tissue) covariates'. Objective B of the expanded-covariate-sources task (2026-09-03), rebuilt 2026-09-04 using the disk-bounded streaming download path (covariates_chromatin.py/download.py) after the original 26-EID plan hit gauss's disk limit. roadmap.eids is the full 127-epigenome Roadmap consolidated panel (E001-E129 excluding E060/E064, which genuinely don't exist -- verified live, not assumed); roadmap.marks adds DNase to the standard 7 histone marks, since Roadmap has its own native DNase-seq tracks via the same egg2.wustl.edu signal system for most EIDs (found while checking E121-E129's coverage), not just histone ChIP. encode_chromatin.tracks is 83 adult primary-tissue DNase-seq experiments from the ENCODE portal (one per unique biosample term, live-queried and life-stage-filtered to exclude embryonic/fetal/newborn/cell-line samples), complementing Roadmap's own DNase coverage with tissues Roadmap's panel doesn't reach. Still excludes H3K23ac/H3K14ac/H2AK9ac: no usable ENCODE coverage exists for any of the three (in-vitro-differentiated stem cells or one QC-flagged experiment only) -- unrelated to disk, a genuine data-availability gap. average_by_assay is true (2026-09-06): the raw per-track columns (roadmap's ~850 real tracks + encode_chromatin's 83) are pooled and collapsed to one averaged column per mark before assembly, rather than PCA-reduced as ~1860 separate per-track columns -- collapsing first cheaply outperforms PCA at the small component counts a per-cohort model can support, confirmed by 5-fold gene-CV against several TCGA cohorts' own covariate matrices. Cell lines added 2026-09-07: Martincorena et al. 2017's own STAR Methods (the primary paper, not just the dndscv package/GitHub repo, finally accessed this session) states plainly that dNdScv's 169-track/20-PC matrix came from '63 cell lines' in the Roadmap Epigenomics Project, not primary tissue -- a real, previously-unverified gap in GENERIC's own pool (which until now was 127 Roadmap epigenomes, mostly primary tissue/cells, plus 83 ENCODE adult-tissue DNase tracks, deliberately life-stage-filtered to EXCLUDE cell lines). Queried ENCODE's own portal restricted to biosample_ontology.classification=cell+line for all 7 default histone marks plus DNase (output_type 'fold change over control' for histone, 'read-depth normalized signal' for DNase, GRCh38): 211 distinct cell lines, 548 (line, mark) track pairs, zero overlap with GENERIC's existing 83 tissue-only DNase accessions. All 548 added here, unfiltered by tissue -- GENERIC is tissue-agnostic by design, so cell-line identity (unlike the per-cohort matrices' tissue-matching requirement) is not a rejection criterion here. Also added the 3 rare marks' full cell-line pool (H3K23ac/H3K14ac/H2AK9ac -- 7 biosamples: IMR-90, mesenchymal stem cell, H1, H9, trophoblast cell, neuronal stem cell, mesendoderm; 12 track pairs), the only place in this registry these 3 marks now appear at all, since no per-cohort tissue match exists for them (checked: IMR-90/H1/trophoblast/H9/mesenchymal-stem-cell/neuronal-stem-cell/mesendoderm match none of our 13 registered cohort tissues). average_by_assay's collapsing means this addition changes the resulting ~17-18 columns' underlying sample composition and precision, not their count -- consistent with why the mechanism was adopted in the first place (2026-09-06). repliseq added 2026-10-02 as a pooled_mrt source, so GENERIC is now the complete tissue-agnostic matrix (pooled chromatin, pan-tissue expression median, pooled replication timing): 108 profiles over 50 human biosamples -- every replication-timing experiment on the ENCODE portal enumerated by assay_title (Repli-seq + Repli-chip, the 182 of the assay_slims facet; 15 UW 6-fraction lines reduced to mean replication time, 33 Repli-chip biosamples and 5 Gilbert-lab Repli-seq series as sign-flipped wavelets; T47D excluded, it has no usable signal files) plus the GSE137764 HCT116 16-fraction MAT. Pooled column rt_pool_z correlates 0.91 with HCT116 alone; median pairwise correlation between biosamples 0.75.
